## Greater Gravity Elemental (CR 9)

**XP** 6,400  
 N Huge outsider (elemental, extraplanar, gravity)  
 **Init** +13; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +16  

**Defense**

 **AC** 20, touch 20, flat-footed 10 (+2 deflection, +9 Dex, +1 dodge, -2 size)  
 **hp** 208 (13d10+78)  
 **Fort** +9; **Ref** +16; **Will** +8  
 **Defensive Abilities** distortion;  
 **DR** 10/—; **Immune** elemental traits, missile weapons, mass-dependent spells  

**Offense**

 **Speed** fly 100 ft. (perfect)  
 **Melee** 2 slams +21 (1d8+9)  
 **Ranged** missile +20 (damage by type)  
 **Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** engulf, gravity field (crush 6/day, 30 ft. radius, DC 22, 4d6 bludgeoning)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 22, **Dex** 29, **Con** 20, **Int** 6, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 11  
 **Base Atk** +13; **CMB** +24; **CMD** 43  
 **Feats** Cleave, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative, [Throw Anything](../../rules/feats/throw-anything.md), [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), [Weapon Focus (slam)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge and Mobility are one feat, Dodgility; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (slam), Toughness; Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
 **Skills** Fly +28, Perception +16, Sense Motive +16, Stealth +17  
 **SQ** perfect flier  

**Special Abilities**

 **Distortion (Su)** The manipulation of light waves around a gravity elemental grants it a +2 deflection bonus to its Armor Class.  

 **Engulf (Ex)** A gravity elemental that starts its turn grappling a creature or holding and object up to one size smaller than itself can absorb the creature or object into its swirling form as a full-round action. An engulfed creature or object takes damage equal to the elemental’s slam attack each round it remains engulfed and can take no action other than trying to break free by rolling its CMB vs. the gravity elementals CMD. The gravity elemental gains the grappled condition as long as it has a creature engulfed, and it can only engulf one creature at a time.
